method.source_denominator: exactly the 36 rows frozen by the responsive-link offline field-review protocol
method.candidate_pair_denominator: every candidate field listed for every frozen review row, in protocol order
method.evidence_complete_rule: the fixed source directly states a bounded current or period-specific authority, date, waiver disposition, screening rule, or verification surface without bridging an omitted element
method.partial_rule: the source directly supports part of the combined field but omits a required dimension such as geography, governing dates, exercised use, exact operative instrument, or substantive standard
method.ambiguity_rule: the source is relevant but its date, scope, temporal relation, or authority cannot be safely converted into an operative field value
method.no_support_rule: complete review of this fixed extracted source did not recover relevant support; this is not a policy-absence claim
method.promotion_rule: even an evidence-complete disposition is only a promotion candidate; this transaction has no matrix-update or terminalization authority
